title: Quantized Loops
tagline: Compare four scheduling strategies for fixed-latency loop unrolling in embedded kernels.

curves.label: Full Unroll
curves.code: for (i=0; i<n; i++){ /* fully unrolled body */ acc += f(i); } // instruction bloat
curves.name: Full Unroll

curves.label: Tiled Unroll
curves.code: const T=16; for (t=0; t<n; t+=T){ for(i=t;i<Math.min(n,t+T);i++){ acc += f(i); } } // tile-local scheduling
curves.name: Tiled Unroll

curves.label: JIT Specialization
curves.code: if(!cache[n]) cache[n]=compileUnrolledVariant(n); run(cache[n]); // compile amortized into execution
curves.name: JIT Specialization

curves.label: Polyhedral Loop Nest
curves.code: schedule = polyhedralOptimize(loopNest, constraints); emit(schedule); run(loopNest); // dependence-aware ordering
curves.name: Polyhedral Loop Nest
